widgets_values: A realistic full-body dance with natural motion and consistent appearance.

1. Upload/select any dance video.
2. Keep original character/background, or upload/select replacements.
3. Upload any number of outfits in appearance order (one file = one outfit).
   Reorder filenames in outfit_images; [] keeps source clothing.
4. Queue once. All outfit sections render and join automatically.

Outfits share equal time by default. Optional outfit_durations assigns seconds to each outfit, covering the full video. Long outfit intervals split into smaller renders. Output keeps the source aspect ratio, complete 24 fps timeline and soundtrack (when present). Cuts have context frames trimmed away; pose/identity fidelity still needs visual review. Find clips, graphs and reports under output/h3/dance/. This is a configurable ComfyUI workflow; the Python/CLI generation pipeline is unchanged.
